Package cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.config

Class UserAuthProvider

java.lang.Object
cz.cuni.mff.vopalenf.annotator.config.UserAuthProvider
@Component public class UserAuthProvider extends Object
UserAuthProvider is responsible for creating and validating JWT tokens for user authentication.

  • Method Details

    • init

      @PostConstruct public void init()
      Initializes the secret key. If not provided via environment variable, generates a secure random key. The key is then encoded in Base64 format.
